verdict.rationale: Codegen has no documented agent-readiness assessment that flags failing criteria and fixes them automatically. Adjacent capabilities exist: the agent can analyze repository structure and generate setup commands, and it can analyze sandbox setup logs to identify errors and suggest solutions. Both partially address making a repository workable for agents, but neither is framed as remediating readiness criteria. Missing for 10: an explicit agent-readiness criteria report, automatic remediation of failing criteria (e.g., generating agent rule files or config via PR), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
